base: Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent character portrait for a 2D narrative game's dialogue. Image 1 is ONLY the art-style reference: its large portrait on the right has expressive dark hand-drawn ink outlines, subtle pencil texture, muted anime cel shading and gothic storybook melancholy. Image 2 is the exact approved character design to preserve. Create ONE illustrated portrait of the character from image 2, from head to upper thighs, three-quarter front view facing slightly toward the LEFT into the dialogue. Keep all of the head, hair, shoulders and hands inside the image. Same consistent illustrated art direction as the reference, NOT pixel art, NOT realistic, NOT 3D. Preserve age, gender presentation, hairstyle and clothing from the sprite/design described. Give the face and hands readable simple shapes; quiet neutral idle pose, no action. Transparent background with clean alpha, no environment, no text, no name, no border, no UI. The name Leonard in the example is illustrative only and must not appear. Do not copy the reference character's blindfold or purple hair unless the target character actually has that trait.

characters.kali: Kali: short adolescent boy with long messy red hair, rounded-corner glasses. Dirty white long-sleeve shirt under a faded black short-sleeve T-shirt, loose torn black pants. Personality must remain open to player choices: pose is thoughtful and cautious, one hand gently holding the opposite sleeve near the wrist, attentive gaze to the left. Do not portray aggression or forced cheerfulness.
characters.noah: Noah: adolescent boy of medium height, swept blond/light-brown hair, light blue collared shirt with dark trousers. Attentive, communicative and obedient to adult authority. Upright composed posture, one open hand in a modest explaining gesture, other arm relaxed, alert and polite expression without a broad grin.
characters.mira: Mira: short adolescent girl with long straight black hair and light-colored long-sleeve blouse, dark pants. Shy, observant and worried about the surroundings. Shoulders slightly inward, hands gently clasped against her torso, cautious sideways gaze toward the left. No smiling glamour pose.
characters.eron: Eron: adolescent boy of medium height, tousled purple hair, dark buttoned jacket/shirt with a small collar and charcoal pants. Reserved and downcast because his friend Tomas disappeared. Slightly bowed head, loose crossed arms with one hand holding the other upper arm, tired pensive eyes. No blindfold. Keep eyes visible and purple hair exposed; no added hood.
characters.tomas: Tomas: adolescent boy of medium height, long straight black hair, round framed glasses, dirty off-white hoodie, torn black pants. Warm personal connection to Eron, cautious resilience. One hand near his hoodie pocket, the other lightly resting on his chest, quiet reassuring expression and a slight restrained half smile. Preserve glasses.
characters.vigia: Vigia: tall adult, black hooded cloak and dark uniform, the hood deeply shadowing the upper face, visible lower face. Reserved, objective, questioning authority. Rigid upright stance, arms crossed firmly, watchful closed mouth. No golden decorations and no cane.
characters.lider: Líder: tall adult leader of the watchers, dark hooded cloak with unmistakable gold trim and gold details. Holds an amethyst cane with a bright purple crystal at the top. Institutional authority, calm control and pressure. Both hands deliberately resting on the cane at chest/waist level, erect composed posture, shadowed upper face and serious lower face. Keep crystal and hands fully visible.
characters.daty: Daty: short adult mother with medium-length wavy brown hair, white overcoat with black trim/details and pale blue trousers. Gentle protective presence from Kali's family memory. A hand over her heart, other hand relaxed, compassionate concerned expression, mature face distinct from teenagers.
characters.inauri: Inauri: tall adult father with sparse thinning brown hair, dark blue dress shirt and white pants. Quiet steady parental presence. Relaxed upright posture, one hand loosely resting on his forearm at waist level, calm thoughtful expression, mature face with receding hairline. No full head of hair.
